{{Top}}
{{Quote|I had just enough warning to allow me to gulp in a lungful of air.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Star Wars Journal: The Fight for Justice">''[[Star Wars Journal: The Fight for Justice]]''</ref>}}
A '''lung''' was a major internal organ. For those organisms which possessed lungs, the organs played a vital role in the breathing and respiration processes. Most species, including [[Human/Legends|Humans]], had two lungs,<ref name="Alien Races">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref> The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] species had strong and sturdy lungs which allowed them to hold their breath for extended periods, enabling them able to travel freely to their underwater cities.<ref name="SWE Gungans">{{SWE|groups|gungans|Gungans}}</ref>

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], a Human who, as the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Vader, had his lungs seared after he was immolated on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], managed to survive until his master, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], came to rescue him soon thereafter. The Bith [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ulaha Kore]] died of injuries she sustained during the disastrous [[Mission to Myrkr]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the most damaging of which was the puncturing of her single lung.<ref name="sbs">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>

The lungs of the [[Breather Gand|breather]] [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] were adapted to breathing only [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]] and could be damaged by [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] inhalation.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], a Gand [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], suffered lung damage some time during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was eventually treated onboard the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']] after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="OPF">{{StoryCite|story=Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>

Lung diseases could also occur, such as [[ascomycetous pneumoconiosis]], [[asthma]], [[Merthian lung infection]], [[pneumonia]], and [[cancer]].<ref name="TRG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> A pair of illegally [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] lungs could cost 50,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="WDNtS">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050120a|text=We Don't Need That Scum}}</ref>
